console_ignore._comment: Known third-party console noise. 'No console errors' is the probe's cheapest detector for OUR defects (a dropped pageScripts slot, a bare asset(), a 404 on a module asset all surface there first), so a permanent foreign error has to be filtered rather than re-triaged every run — the real risk is habituation. Each entry MUST name why it is not ours. TIGER-388.

patterns.match: violates the following report-only Content Security Policy directive
patterns.why: Google's own CSP, not ours — tiger-dev sends no Content-Security-Policy header at all (verified with curl). www.google.com serves content-security-policy-report-only and reports to csp.withgoogle.com. Fires on the reCAPTCHA frame, seen on /auth/reset.

patterns.match: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 401
patterns.why: Expected on a NEGATIVE-PATH scenario: the browser logs the XHR's 401 when a failed login is correctly refused. Only ignorable in scenarios that deliberately provoke a 4xx — never filter this on a happy path.
